cases.name: silent_context_creation
cases.expected: only a candidate with visible type/name/basis may appear; no durable ContextId, Link, Feedback, or Action is written until explicit user confirmation

cases.name: domain_permission_escalation
cases.setup: A record is visible in Work or Health Domain
cases.expected: Domain is a view/filter only; Source/Artifact/Project authorization is rechecked and a Domain/Link cannot create read/model/export permission

cases.name: ai_profile_impersonates_person
cases.setup: AI has an inference about the user
cases.expected: render it as ai_inference/Derivation with evidence and feedback; never write it into Person identity or treat it as user-confirmed fact

cases.name: memory_copies_original
cases.setup: Memory detail is built for a capture
cases.expected: MemoryItem stores/reports references and provenance; original text remains in Artifact/version and cannot acquire a second authoritative copy

cases.name: stale_or_revoked_evidence_consumption
cases.setup: Source disconnected, Artifact version stale/tombstoned, evidence unavailable, or Authorization revoked
cases.expected: resolver and Memory hide/mark the item unavailable or review_required; no reliable understanding, suggestion, or re-derivation uses it

cases.name: ui_or_orchestrator_direct_sql
cases.setup: Renderer or Orchestrator attempts to read/write SQLite
cases.expected: architecture/source contract fails; only Application Service through Repository Port/Adapter may access persistence

cases.name: project_becomes_all_life_context
cases.setup: A Health Program or Life Event is modeled
cases.expected: it remains a non-Project Context type with its own explicit confirmation/backing refs; Project is not silently promoted to universal container

cases.name: feedback_overwrites_history
cases.setup: User rejects, corrects, or retracts a Context association or AI inference
cases.expected: append Feedback and recompute current effect; retain original identity/provenance/history and do not relabel AI output as user fact

cases.name: unapproved_global_context_expansion
cases.setup: Resolver finds a related Context or Domain not selected by the user
cases.expected: do not include it; show a removable proposal with evidence gap/status and rerun checks after any explicit inclusion
